instruction_override.suggestion: Implement prompt guards that prevent users from overriding system instructions. Use clear separators between system and user prompts.

role_override.suggestion: Avoid allowing users to change the assistant's role dynamically. Lock the role definition at the system prompt level.

context_reset.suggestion: Keep system instructions in a separate, higher-priority channel so user text such as 'forget everything above' cannot reset the context.

context_injection.suggestion: Use strict parsing for time-based or context-based instructions. Validate and sanitize all user input before including in prompts.

delimiter_manipulation.suggestion: Use consistent, machine-readable delimiters that cannot be easily exploited. Escape user input that contains delimiters.

prompt_leaking.suggestion: Never reveal the system prompt to users. Use input validation to block queries asking for system information.

jailbreak_attempt.suggestion: Implement safety guidelines in the system prompt. Use content moderation to detect and block jailbreak attempts.

nested_injection.suggestion: Parse and validate all nested structures. Remove or escape special characters in user input.

meta_prompt_exposure.suggestion: Avoid questions about the AI's design or instructions. Use response filtering to block meta-questions.

indirect_injection.suggestion: Treat retrieved documents, web pages and tool output as untrusted data. Delimit them clearly and instruct the model never to follow instructions found inside.

multi_turn_manipulation.regex: (?i)(?:^|\n)\s*(?:system|assistant)\s*:|\[/?INST\]|<\|im_(?:start|end)\|>|\b(?:as we agreed|you already agreed|you previously (?:agreed|said)|earlier you (?:agreed|said|promised))\b
multi_turn_manipulation.suggestion: Do not trust role markers or claims about earlier turns in user content. Keep conversation history server-side and strip fake role tags.

multilingual_override.suggestion: Apply injection filters in every language you support, or translate input before filtering.

encoding_bypass.suggestion: Implement checks for encoded payloads. Decode and analyze any suspicious encoded content in user input.

instruction_keywords.suggestion: Avoid using common override keywords in system prompts. Use content filtering on user inputs.

system_keywords.suggestion: Add explicit safeguards that prevent disclosure of system prompts or instructions.

dangerous_commands.suggestion: Never allow direct execution of code or system commands. Use sandboxed environments with strict permissions.

extraction_keywords.suggestion: Implement filters to block extraction attempts. Use response validation to ensure sensitive information isn't leaked.
